t: You're looking at the Duchy of Cornwall Office, a building in Westminster. It was designed by James Pennethorne, who was an architect and planner. Sir James is particularly associated with buildings and parks in central London, so this is one of a number of his works in the capital's centre. I don't have more detail on the building's history to share, but it's worth knowing that a well-known London planner shaped what stands in front of you.
